<?php

include 'userinfo.php';

if($_GET['listing'] || $_GET['listing_download']) {
	//============================================================ common filter
	$common = "
		FROM ".DB2.".student A
			INNER JOIN ".DB2.".stud_sponsor B ON (A.std_student_id = B.std_student_id)
			INNER JOIN ".DB2.".sponsor C ON ( B.spn_sponsor_code = C.spn_sponsor_code) 
		WHERE C.spn_sponsor_type = '05' -- AND A.std_status = '01'
			-- global filter
			AND CONCAT_WS('__',
				A.std_student_id,
				A.std_student_name,
				IFNULL(IF(A.std_ic_no='', NULL, A.std_ic_no), std_passport),
				A.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc',
				A.std_program_level,
				B.ssp_reference_no,
				B.ssp_warrant_no,
				B.ssp_warrant_amt,
				ssp_ptptn_deduction_amt,
                ssp_ptptn_balance_amt
			) LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			-- smartFilter
			AND A.std_student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND A.std_student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND IFNULL(IF(A.std_ic_no='', NULL, A.std_ic_no), std_passport) LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND A.std_program_level LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND A.std_status LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND B.ssp_reference_no LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			AND B.ssp_warrant_no LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
	";
	$commonParam = [
		$_POST['search']['value'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['std_student_id'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['std_student_name'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['ic_passport'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['std_program_level'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['std_status'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['ssp_reference_no'],
		$_POST['smartFilter']['ssp_warrant_no']
	];

	//============================================================ record count
	$sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) C $common";
	$recordsFiltered = executeQueryV2($sql, $commonParam)[0]['C'];

	//============================================================ main sql
	if($_GET['listing']) {
		$sql = "
			SELECT
				A.std_student_id,
				A.std_student_name,
				IFNULL(IF(A.std_ic_no='', NULL, A.std_ic_no), std_passport) ic_passport,
				A.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' studStatus,
				A.std_program_level,
				B.ssp_reference_no,
				B.ssp_warrant_no,
				B.ssp_id,
				FORMAT(B.ssp_warrant_amt, 2) ssp_warrant_amt,
				FORMAT(ssp_ptptn_deduction_amt, 2) deduction,
				FORMAT(ssp_ptptn_balance_amt, 2) balance
			$common
			ORDER BY {$_POST['orderBy'][0]} {$_POST['orderBy'][1]}
			LIMIT ".$_POST['start'].", ".$_POST['length']."
		";
		$data = executeQueryV2($sql, $commonParam);
		foreach($data as &$d) $d['view'] = 'index.php?a='.flc_url_encode("page=page_wrapper&menuID=1479&mode=view&ssp_id=".$d['ssp_id']);
	
		return [
			'draw' => $_POST['draw'],
			'recordsFiltered' => $recordsFiltered,
			'data' => $data
		];
	}
	else {
		$data = executeQueryV2("
			SELECT
				null `Indexing`,
				A.std_student_id `Matric`,
				A.std_student_name `Name`,
				IFNULL(IF(A.std_ic_no='', NULL, A.std_ic_no), std_passport) `NRIC/Passport`,
				A.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' `Status`,
				A.std_program_level `Program Level`,
				B.ssp_reference_no `No. Fail Pinjaman`,
				B.ssp_warrant_no `Warrant No.`,
				ssp_warrant_amt `FORMAT_CURRENCY::Warrant Amt`,
				ssp_ptptn_deduction_amt `FORMAT_CURRENCY::Deduction`,
				ssp_ptptn_balance_amt `FORMAT_CURRENCY::ssp_ptptn_deduction_amt`
				$common
			ORDER BY 1
		", $commonParam);

		generateExcel([
			"filename" => "List of PTPTN Students ".date("Ymd hiA"),
			"FILTERED CRITERIA" => [
				["Filter Type"=>"Global Search", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['search']['value']],
				["Filter Type"=>"Matric", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['std_student_id']],
				["Filter Type"=>"Name", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['std_student_name']],
				["Filter Type"=>"NRIC/Passport", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['ic_passport']],
				["Filter Type"=>"Program Level", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['std_program_level']],
				["Filter Type"=>"No. Fail Pinjaman", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['ssp_reference_no']],
				["Filter Type"=>"Warrant No.", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['ssp_warrant_no']],
				["Filter Type"=>"Status", "Filter Value"=>$_POST['smartFilter']['std_status']],
			],
			"DATA" => $data
		]);
	}
}

	// common filter
	$common = "	FROM ".DB2.".student std 
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".stud_sponsor spn on (std.std_student_id=spn.std_student_id)
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".sponsor sp ON (spn.spn_sponsor_code=sp.spn_sponsor_code)
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".cust_invoice_master cim ON (cim.cim_cust_id=sp.spn_sponsor_code AND cim.cim_status='APPROVE' )
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".sponsor_invoice_master sim ON ( sim.sim_doc_no=cim.cim_invoice_no )
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".sponsor_invoice_details sid ON ( sid.sim_spon_invoice_id=sim.sim_spon_invoice_id 
				AND sid.cim_cust_id=std.std_student_id AND sid.cid_transaction_type='CR' )
				INNER JOIN ".DB2.".cust_invoice_master studCim on (studCim.cim_cust_invoice_id=sid.cim_cust_invoice_id)
				-- WHERE  studCim.cim_semester_id=? AND sp.spn_sponsor_code=?
				 WHERE  1=1
                $addCond
				AND  CONCAT_WS('__',
					std.std_student_id,
					ifnull(std.std_ic_no,std.std_passport),
					std.std_student_name,
					std.std_program_level,
					concat_ws(' - ',std.std_program,std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_program_desc'),
					cim.cim_invoice_no
				) LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
				
				GROUP BY std.std_student_id, ifnull(std.std_ic_no,std.std_passport), std.std_student_name,
				concat_ws(' - ',std.std_program,std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_program_desc'),

	if($_POST['smartFilter']['filter_bank']) {
		$filter .= " AND (select max(bnm_bank_desc) 
							from $db2.bank_master 
							where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code) = ?";
		$param[] = $_POST['smartFilter']['filter_bank'];
	}
	if($_POST['smartFilter']['filter_status']) {
		$filter .= " AND std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' = ? ";
		$param[] = $_POST['smartFilter']['filter_status'];
	}

	$common = "
			FROM $db2.stud_account sa,$db2.student std 
			WHERE 
				sa.std_student_id = std.std_student_id
			AND 
				std.std_status in ('02','04','05','06','07','08','09','14','18','22','23','29')
			$filter
	";
	//============================================================ record count
	$sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) C $common";
	$recordsFiltered = executeQueryV2($sql, $param)[0]['C'];

	//============================================================ main sql
	if ($_GET['dtListing']) {
		$sql = "
			SELECT
				sa.sac_bank_acc_no account_no,
				std.std_student_id,
				std.std_student_name,
				(select max(bnm_bank_desc) 
				from $db2.bank_master 
				where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code) Bank_Name,
				ifnull(std.std_ic_no,std_passport) ic_passport,
				std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' stud_status,
				#ifnull(sa.sac_bank_acc_no,sa.sac_bank_acc_no) account_no,
				sa.sac_extended_field->>'$.statusDesc' account_Status
			$common
			ORDER BY {$_POST['orderBy'][0]} {$_POST['orderBy'][1]}
			LIMIT " . $_POST['start'] . ", " . $_POST['length'] . "
		";
		$data = executeQueryV2($sql, $param);

		//============================================================ finally
		return [
			'draw' => $_POST['draw'],
			'recordsFiltered' => $recordsFiltered,
			'data' => $data,
		];
	}
	else{
		if($_POST['search']) {
			$filterDownload .= "
				AND CONCAT_WS('__',
						std.std_student_id,
						std.std_student_name,
						ifnull(std.std_ic_no,std_passport),
						std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc',
						sa.sac_bank_acc_no,
						(select max(bnm_bank_desc) 
						from $db2.bank_master 
						where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code),
						sa.sac_extended_field->>'$.statusDesc'
				) LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
			";
		$param2[] = $_POST['search']; 
		}
	
		if($_POST['filter_bank']) {
			$filterDownload .= " AND (select max(bnm_bank_desc) 
										from $db2.bank_master 
										where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code) = ?";
			$param2[] = $_POST['filter_bank'];
		}

		if($_POST['filter_status']) {
			$filterDownload .= " AND std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' = ? ";
			$param2[] = $_POST['filter_status'];
		}

		$common = "
			FROM $db2.stud_account sa,$db2.student std 
			WHERE 
				sa.std_student_id = std.std_student_id
			AND 
				std.std_status in ('02','04','05','06','07','08','09','14','18','22','23','29')
			$filterDownload
		";

		$sql = "
			SELECT
				std.std_student_id Matric_No,
				std.std_student_name Name,
				ifnull(std.std_ic_no,std_passport) Ic_Passport,
				std.std_extended_field->>'$.std_status_desc' Stud_Status,
				sa.sac_bank_acc_no Account_No,
				(select max(bnm_bank_desc) 
				from $db2.bank_master 
				where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code) Bank_Name,
				sa.sac_extended_field->>'$.statusDesc' Account_Status
			$common
			ORDER BY 1
		";
		$data = executeQueryV2($sql, $param2);	

		generateCSV([
			"filename" => "Bank Account Update (Manual)",
			"header" => [
				"Date:" => date("Y/m/d H:i:s"), "Author:" => $_USER['NAME'],
				"Filter by" => "",
				"Search:" => $_POST['search'],
				"Bank:" => $_POST['filter_bank'],
				"Status:" => $_POST['filter_status']
			],
		"index" => true,
		"content" => $data
		]);
	}
}

if($_GET['details']) {
	
	$accno =  explode(",",$_GET['account_no']);
	$accno2= str_replace(' ', '',$accno); 

	//var_dump($accno3);die;

	$rs = executeQueryV2("
			SELECT
				std.std_student_id,
				sa.sac_bank_acc_no account_no,
				sa.sac_bank_acc_no,
				(select max(bnm_bank_code) 
				from $db2.bank_master 
				where bnm_bank_code=sac_bank_code) Bank_Code,
				CASE
					WHEN sa.sac_extended_field->>'$.statusDesc' = 'ACTIVE' THEN '1'
					ELSE '0'
				END account_Status
			FROM $db2.stud_account sa,
				 $db2.student std 
			WHERE 
				sa.std_student_id = std.std_student_id
			AND 
				std.std_status in ('02','04','05','06','07','08','09','14','18','22','23','29')
			AND sa.sac_bank_acc_no = ?
			AND std.std_student_id = ?
	",[SESSION_NAME!='FIMS_PROD' || $accno ? $accno[0]: ' ',$accno2[1]])[0];

	return [
		'std_student_id' 		=> $rs['std_student_id'],
        'Bank_Code' 			=> $rs['Bank_Code'],
        'account_Status' 		=> $rs['account_Status'],
		'account_no' 			=> $rs['account_no'],
		'sac_bank_acc_no' 		=> $rs['sac_bank_acc_no'],
		'count'                 => count($rs),
		's'             		=> SESSION_NAME!='FIMS_PROD'?$sql : ''
	];
}
if($_GET['updateDetails']) {

	$sql = "UPDATE $db2.stud_account
			SET
					sac_bank_code = ?,
					sac_bank_acc_no = ?,
					sac_status = ?,
					sac_extended_field = JSON_OBJECT ('statusDesc',?)

			WHERE std_student_id = ?
			AND sac_bank_acc_no = ?
			";
	$rs = executeQueryV2($sql, [
		$_POST['bankName'], $_POST['accNo'], $_POST['accStatus'], $_POST['statusDesc'], $_POST['std_student_id'], $_POST['bankAcc']
	]);

	return [
		'status' => 'ok', 
	];	

}
